scope: Every assert and wait/barrier in recovery_cases.py, recovery_campaign.py, campaign_fixture.py and the consumed WALFixture setup methods; registry maps all31+2 cases. Go actors and PostgreSQL tools remain unchanged independent observers, consumed through these assertions. Required command status and input/resource/cleanup boundaries below are additional fail-closed harness contracts; optional forensics are explicitly DIAGNOSTICS, not assertions.

runtime_boundaries.requirement: Optional bounded forensic logs/events/status and their artifacts persist typed warnings in manifest.diagnostics outside failures, case status and acceptance. All independent collectors and safe retirement continue; optional errors never discard fixtures or interrupt retention/cleanup. Startup/absence/auth/transport/deadline/cap errors are not backup assertions. Required manifest/identity persistence remains fail-closed outside the optional catch.

Explicit oracle-required logs/markers/SQL/WAL/UID/holder/ownership observations remain mandatory and outside optional collection. Missing required evidence fails closed. Pod quiescence, original operation closure, unchanged source holders and owned backing retirement remain mandatory despite diagnostic errors.

Import the exact SHA256-verified archive directly into kind and verify its canonical config digest in consuming containerd. Docker classic/config and containerd/manifest display IDs are not interchangeable. Wrong archive, platform or consumed config is rejected.
A nonzero status, killed child, exceeded deadline or truncated oracle input is never successful proof. Separate bounded diagnostics retain actual status; all child groups are reaped.
Absence follows a successful exact Docker list, never empty stdout from an unsuccessful inspect or version-specific error text.
Exact owned identities and no remaining CRI/mount consumers before disposal. Unknown associations and cleanup errors block slot reuse; no marker/source-hold clearing.

Admit the aggregate recipe before provisioning; observe actual cgroup limits/pressure, demand allocation and emergency floor. Hard node limits apply during bootstrap; no arbitrary endpoint or resource waiver.

Canonical frozen subject, exact unchanged bundle/source/runtime/registry, all31+2 completed, no failures/retention/leaks/missing or mismatched attempts. Diagnostic or partial scope is never full fresh qualification.

reviewed_dispositions: Removed instant adoption, instant Job Complete and live-Pod-after-durable-proof assumptions (existing repaired oracles preserved).
Removed redundant permissive log-wording assertion in reject and cleaning-log substring assertion in replacement; actual nonzero recovery/guard reason and independent no-mutation snapshots remain.
Removed exact operation active-state assertion during retry pause: owned holders and eventual exact completion are requirements, projection spelling at that instant is not.
Retained exact SQL, WAL bytes/hashes/native range/endpoints, PID1 same-process adoption/reaping, source holder identity and all-three-target marker oracles.
Namespace finalization waits300s against explicitly configured CNPG smart/stop30/60s, not default1800s. No force/finalizer clearing.
Native record uniqueness/16MiB segment size/one writer/one Job retry parallelism and wrapper placement are explicit fixture preconditions, not universal product contracts.
Unexpected assertion errors retain causal expression identity; fixture precondition failure is not labeled a product failure.
